name: Itazura 4 ~Ore-tachi no Sentou Sharyou~
original_name: 悪戯4～俺たちの戦闘車輌～
source:
Main character is a molester with multiple arrests. His jail time really decreased his enthusiasm. One day he witnesses a group of molesters on the train who coordinate their actions on an internet bulletin board. With a group of four people it's much easier to conduct mischief and hide the traces of it, so protagonist joins them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名多次被捕的性骚扰者。入狱的时间确实降低了他的热情。有一天，他在火车上目睹了一群性骚扰者，他们在互联网公告板上协调行动。四人小组更容易恶作剧并隐藏恶作剧的痕迹，所以主角加入了他们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
